name: Caos Primordial
label: Reverência
description: Solemn cosmic reverence and harmonic pacification facing RIGHT toward a sacred celestial sphere. The swirling black ink tendrils gracefully unfurl and dip downward in deference, the pale gold orbital ring tilts gently forward in silent salute while the eclipse core dims softly and aligns calmly, holding a serene reverent suspended posture at the end. Preserve crisp dark hermetic pixel art, same scale and palette. Static camera, transparent background.
